artist.name: Hanniou
artist.short_description: Hanniou — an Afterglow curated emotional-pop discovery profile.
artist.biography: Hanniou is a German singer-songwriter associated with Stuttgart who releases emotionally direct pop under a single-name stage identity. A Stuttgart festival biography identifies her as Hannah, but does not establish a verified full legal name. The same programme describes her early radio exposure through the debut single ‘Angel’ in 2020 and notes a nomination for the German Songwriting Award. Her early releases gathered an audience through online music discovery as well as live performances. Her song ‘heartbeats’ attracted attention after a snippet spread on TikTok; the festival programme connects that moment with support from the FRTYFVE label. Subsequent recordings developed her catalogue of compact, relationship-focused pop songs, including ‘what do i do now’ and material collected on the 2024 ‘Losing You’ EP. Her distributor Kontor New Media described her 2025 ‘you’re just a boy’ EP as moving between pop, bedroom pop and singer-songwriter approaches. That description and the music-service catalogues provide the factual basis for Afterglow’s categorization; the ‘emotional pop’ label is our editorial grouping rather than a formal artist-designated genre. The 2025 distributor feature also discusses touring and the growing audience around her music. For new listeners, Afterglow would present Hanniou as an accessible route into intimate modern pop, with the emotional directness of acoustic songwriting and the brevity of contemporary singles.
